image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a black non-stick frying pan resting on a dark stovetop surface. The pan has a circular basin with sloped sides and a long, metallic handle extending towards the bottom left. The interior surface shows signs of use with some texture and oil sheen. The background is dark and somewhat indistinct, likely the stove grates or surface.
